name: Refill when an ally buffs you
summary: The unit fights on a small stock of shots that comes back slowly by itself. When a teammate's buff lands on it, the whole stock returns at once, and for as long as the buff lasts it also refills faster. The perk belongs to the receiver: the same buff does something else, or nothing extra, for other units. So the unit hits in bursts, empties its stock, and then either waits out the slow refill or gets a teammate to buff it and fires again straight away. It rewards a team that times its buffs to the gun, and it ties the unit's damage to a buffer the enemy can kill, keep away or block.
counterplay: Kill or drive off the buffer: without it the unit is back to one stock that refills slowly.
Count the shots and push when the stock is empty and no buff is in reach.
Make it waste the burst: cover, decoys and shields soak the first stock, and a refilled stock spent on nothing is a wasted buff.
Strike between buffs: a buff on a long cooldown, or one that costs money or a minion, can't come every time.
Where the game has an effect that blocks buffs, put it on the gunner; Tempest Rising's Subjugation does this to infantry.

other_examples.unit: Revenant, Augur, Subjugator, Luminary, Gorgon and Constellation (Veti)
other_examples.note: The same perk sits on six more Veti units and on one structure, the Host Tower. Each fights on a stock that refills by itself over time, and each gets every missing shot back, plus a doubled refill rate, when Consecration lands on it. The wiki lists it beside the other Consecrated perks, through which the same buff gives other receivers wide sight, repairs or income instead.

player_translation.summary: A gun unit with a small stock of heavy shots that refills slowly. When a teammate's buff lands on it, the stock is full again at once and keeps refilling fast while the buff lasts, so one well-timed buff means two bursts in a row.
as_user: You buy a unit whose main weapon holds a few strong shots and gets them back slowly, one at a time.
Fire the stock into a target, then call your buffer: when their buff lands on you, the stock snaps back to full and you fire again straight away.
While the buff lasts your shots also come back faster, so you keep firing through the push.
Without a buffer you are an ordinary burst unit: shoot, wait, shoot. You plan your fights around where the buffer is.
You empty the stock before the buff arrives, since a refill onto a full stock gives nothing.
as_target: You see its ammo pips: when they are empty and no buffer is near, that is the moment to push.
A flash and a sound mark the refill, so the second burst never comes without warning.
Kill or drive off the enemy buffer and this unit is back to slow, single bursts.
Soak the first burst behind cover or with a decoy, and make it spend the refilled one on nothing.
teammates: The buffer and the gunner are a pair: the gunner pings that the stock is empty, and the buffer answers with the call.
Any teammate with a rally or a blessing can feed the gun, so the team picks its buffers knowing who profits most.
One buff over several such units refills all of them at once, which makes a grouped push very strong for a moment.
The enemy coordinates the other way: hunt the buffer, or push together in the empty window.
controls: Nothing to press: the refill fires by itself when an ally's buff lands on you.
Left mouse fires the stock as usual, and the HUD shows a pip for each shot left.
Middle mouse, the universal ping: on an empty stock it tells teammates that you need a boost.
The unit's own abilities never set it off; the buff has to come from a teammate.
feedback: Ammo pips over the unit and on the HUD; on a refill they fill with a flash and a clear reload sound.
While the buff lasts the pips glow and tick back visibly faster.
Buffers see a small ammo icon on teammates who carry this perk and are low, so they know where a call pays double.
Enemies see the same pips and the same flash.
changes_from_rts: In Tempest Rising one commander owns both the thrall and the gunship and clicks them together. Here two players have to time it, so the request ping and the low-ammo icon carry the coordination.
The Vimana is refilled by one particular buff, Consecration. A player version should accept any teammate's rally-type buff, or the perk is dead in most teams.
The Vimana can't set it off with its own Benediction, which never lands on the caster; keep that rule so the unit can't feed itself.
RTS ammo stocks are small counters the player rarely watches. In a shooter the pips must be visible to both teams, since the whole counterplay is counting shots.
A full refill every time a long buff ticks could double a heavy unit's damage for a whole fight; allow one instant refill per buff and let the faster trickle do the rest.

team_play.notes: A two-player combo by design: the gun is fed by a teammate's buff, so buffer and gunner time their play together, and the enemy answers by hunting the buffer or pushing in the empty window. It is the receiving side of the resupply hook.

notes: An event fired when an ally's buff is applied; the perk listens, sets the weapon's stock to full and scales its refill rate while the buff is on.
Needs a weapon with a countable stock that refills by itself (the magazine trait).
Rules to settle: which buffs count, one instant refill per buff, no self-trigger.
Pips over the unit, the refill flash and the low-ammo icon that buffers see.
Two full bursts back to back can delete a target; the stock and the damage per shot must be tuned for the doubled case.
The unit is weak in a team with no buffer and strong in a coordinated one, so it is hard to price for both.
Several buffers taking turns could keep the stock full all the time; limit instant refills per time window.
The enemy must see both the stock and the refill, or the second burst feels like a cheat.
The refill flash has to look different from an ordinary reload and from the buff's own marker.

variants.name: Full refill
variants.summary: Every missing shot returns the moment the buff lands, and the stock refills faster for as long as the buff lasts.
variants.seen_in: Tempest Rising Vimana and the other Veti units with Consecrated Restocking

variants.name: Faster while buffed
variants.summary: No instant refill: the stock simply comes back much faster while the buff is on.
variants.seen_in: Tempest Rising aircraft with Auto Restock under Gravitationally Enhanced; on the giver's side, Destiny 2 Lunafaction Boots and Overwatch Kiriko

variants.name: Any support counts
variants.summary: Every friendly support effect sets it off, a heal, a repair beam or an ammo crate as well as a rally, so the perk still works in a team without a buffer.

variants.name: Charge reset
variants.summary: The buff brings back the unit's ability charges or cuts its cooldowns instead of refilling a gun.
variants.seen_in: As a receiver's perk an original twist; Overwatch Kiriko's Kitsune Rush speeds allies' cooldowns from the giver's side

adds_strengths.why: A teammate's buff hands its abilities straight back, so it can use them twice in one fight.

adds_weaknesses.why: Away from a buffer its abilities sit on long cooldowns, and enemies can wait them out.

variants.name: Fed only by buffs
variants.summary: The stock never refills by itself: away from base, a teammate's buff is the only way to get shots back.

adds_strengths.why: Each buff from a teammate reloads its whole stock on the spot, so with a buffer it never has to leave the front.

adds_weaknesses.why: With no buffer in reach its stock does not come back at all, and once empty it must go back to base.

variants.name: Overfill
variants.summary: The refill may go a shot or two past the normal stock; the extra shots fade when the buff ends.

adds_strengths.why: With a teammate's buff it fires its whole stock twice in a row, a burst no lone unit of its price matches.

adds_weaknesses.why: Away from a buffer it is stuck on a small stock that refills slowly, and enemies can count its shots.

countered_by.why: Flankers hunt the buffer behind it, and without the buff it is back to slow single bursts.
Snipers pick off the buffer before the call that would reload it.
Tough brawlers soak the first burst and close in while the stock is empty.

open_questions: Which buffs count as the trigger: only rally-type buffs, or any friendly support effect such as a heal, a repair or an ammo crate?
Is the perk worth a slot when many teams will have no buffer? Should the generator offer it only when the roster has units that rally?
One instant refill per buff, or one per time window, so that buffers taking turns can't keep the gun full?
Should the same idea cover other bonuses on being buffed (a repair, a helper, wider sight), as the Veti units' other perks do? That would be a wider pattern with this one as a variant.

shooter_fit.reason: A clean two-player combo with a clear cue and clear counterplay: count the shots, kill the buffer. It only works in a team that has a buffer and talks, so it is a weak pick in loose matches, and no shooter was found that puts the rule on the receiver.
